collection.title: Mercedes-Benz GLK Class 2008 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz GLK Class SUV 2008 to 2014 (204) will fit, this model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this GLK Class which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
